notes:
Inspector Elements tab for a variant that is reachable from several screens. Approved model "one parent, other entries are plain edges" (mockup `variants-multi-parent` / `one-parent-edges`), implemented in CHR-732.

- A variant has exactly one home (`variant_of`); every other screen that opens it is an ordinary flow edge.
- Two cards at the top of the Elements tab: `Also reached from · N flow sources` (each source is a link) and the `Variant` card (Path, Kind, Depth, Siblings, Flows in / out). Both are `$variant-card` instances; the rows are plain text in the `body` slot.
- The card list replaces the mockup's stand-alone card beside the phone; the sidebar lists the variant once under its home.
- Link targets are intentionally not wired as flows: the sources named here are illustrative and not screens of this project.
